title: Fix mixed-model vec_cache accounting, partial active-model coverage reporting, and noisy vec-only RRF hits
goal: Keep vector coverage accurate for the active embedding model and prevent unrelated vec-only hits from drowning real results

sections.what: On viwo, codesearch_stats reports embed_model='text-embedding-qwen3-embedding-0.6b' and vec_parts loads 49,083 rows (filename: 1543/9961, function_name: 18127/101864, function: 8163/24968, comment: 21250/100401), meaning ~79% of parts lack active-model vectors while 161,398 legacy text-embedding-embeddinggemma-300m rows remain in vec_cache. However db.stats().vectors_by_part sums across all models without warning, masking the incomplete semantic index. Meanwhile, unfiltered semantic RRF results injected unrelated markdown blocks (e.g. docs/design/event-stream-design-recommendation.md) twice into top-12 results for unrelated queries.
sections.why: Agents trust hybrid semantic results assuming full-repo vector coverage, when most of the codebase is unembedded under the active model and weak cosine hits leak noise into RRF results.
sections.how:
1. In db.stats (src/codesearch/db.py:190-196) and codesearch_stats, compute vectors_by_part for the active embed_model (and optionally active_vectors_coverage_pct per part) instead of summing across orphaned models like embeddinggemma-300m alongside qwen3-embedding-0.6b.
2. Add a prune-old-models / clean-stale-vectors path when embedding model changes (or emit a clear stale_model warning when active model covers <100% of indexed parts).
3. Review MIN_SIMILARITY / PART_WEIGHTS / RRF fusion in src/codesearch/search.py so weak semantic matches against un-matched files do not rank identically high alongside direct keyword hits (e.g. score ~0.01587 returning unrelated markdown blocks twice).
sections.verify:
1. Run codesearch_stats(index='viwo'): verify active embed_model coverage (qwen3: 41,310 rows / 49,083 parts loaded) is clearly distinguished from legacy embeddinggemma-300m rows (161,398) rather than hidden in combined vectors_by_part totals.
2. Search 'knowledge language skill proficiency school hobby math science background' on viwo and confirm unrelated design docs (event-stream-design-recommendation.md) do not outrank or crowd genuine symbol/doc matches.

acceptance.text: codesearch_stats reports vector coverage broken down by the currently configured embed_model vs. total node_parts so partial coverage (~21% in qwen3 vs 161k orphaned embeddinggemma rows) is immediately visible
CLI/index pipeline offers an option or automatic prompt/warning to prune orphaned vec_cache rows from inactive models or backfill missing active-model vectors
Unfiltered hybrid searches with keyword hits do not surface low-signal vec:function chunks from unrelated markdown documents above multi-keyword matches without minimum similarity/fusion gating

evidence: Updated db.stats() in src/codesearch/db.py to report active embed_model vectors_by_part, parts_total_by_part, active_coverage_pct, stale_models, and stale_model_warning.
Added db.prune_stale_vectors() and `codesearch embed --prune-stale` in src/codesearch/cli.py.
Added VEC_ONLY_MIN_SIMILARITY (0.55) gating in Searcher.search() when kw_ids is non-empty.
